info.title: Bhulan GPS API
info.description: Mobility insights and map plotting for GPS coordinates, plus ingestion endpoints for vendor feeds.

post.description:
Compute mobility insights for a batch of GPS coordinates.

Accepts either a structured ``points`` array (fast path) or raw ``text``
that the server will parse using :func:`bhulan.analytics.parsers.parse_any`.
Setting ``options.geocode_stops = true`` enriches each detected stop
with a Nominatim-derived ``place_name`` (adds ~1s per unique stop).

When the caller is authenticated (``Authorization: Bearer <session>``)
and server-side auth is enabled, the run is also persisted to the
user's history — look it up with ``GET /v1/history``.

Parse an uploaded GPS file and return normalized points.

Dispatches on the filename extension: ``.gpx`` → gpxpy, ``.kml`` →
stdlib XML, ``.fit`` → fitdecode, anything else → the text parsers.
Files over ``MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES`` are rejected; the content is read into
memory once and parsed synchronously (parsing is CPU-bound and fast
enough that pushing it to a threadpool isn't worth it at this scale).

Parse and validate coordinates for the map view.

Returns the cleaned points plus counts of accepted and rejected rows so
the frontend can show a short summary alongside the rendered track.

Compare 2+ tracks side by side.

Applies the same ``options`` to every track so users don't have to
tune knobs per-track. The response is a list of per-track reports
plus a pooled-hotspot list so the UI can render "shared places"
separately from per-track breakdowns.

get.description:
Liveness probe that doesn't touch Mongo.

Used by Docker / uptime monitors to decide whether the process is up —
``/health/ready`` still exists for the ingestion subsystem's DB check.

Health check endpoint.

Returns 200 if service is ready and database is accessible.

Get non-sensitive configuration.

Returns selected configuration values for debugging.

post.description:
Ingest GPS track points via webhook.

Accepts JSON payload with GPS data, normalizes it, and persists to database.

Args:
    payload: JSON object or array of GPS records
    vendor: Vendor identifier (generic, geotab, samsara)
    ingest_id: Optional ingestion job ID (generated if not provided)
    x_bhulan_mapping: Optional custom mapping JSON in header

Returns:
    NormalizationResult with accepted/rejected counts and errors

get.description:
Get ingestion job status and statistics.

Args:
    ingest_id: Ingestion job identifier

Returns:
    Job information including status, stats, and errors

AuthRequestResponse.title: AuthRequestResponse
AuthRequestResponse.description:
Response to :func:`request_magic_link`.

``dev_magic_link`` is only populated when the server is running with
``AUTH_DEV_MODE=true`` (or without SMTP configured) so a developer can
copy the link without running a mail server. It's never set in
production.

place_name.description: Reverse-geocoded label for the centroid. Only populated when InsightsOptions.geocode_stops is true.

HotspotOut.title: HotspotOut
HotspotOut.description:
One detected density cluster.

``time_spent_min`` is ``None`` when the input has no timestamps —
we can still identify the hotspot geographically, we just can't
say how long was spent there.

merge_stops_within_m.title: Merge Stops Within M
merge_stops_within_m.description: If set, merge consecutive stops whose centroids are within this radius

geocode_stops.title: Geocode Stops
geocode_stops.description: If true, reverse-geocode each stop's centroid via Nominatim and populate StopOut.place_name. Respects Nominatim's 1 req/sec limit; expect +N seconds latency for N unique stops.

trip_split_stop_minutes.title: Trip Split Stop Minutes
trip_split_stop_minutes.description: Stops longer than this end the current trip and start a new one. Shorter stops stay inside the trip they happen during.

trip_split_gap_minutes.title: Trip Split Gap Minutes
trip_split_gap_minutes.description: A gap between consecutive samples longer than this ends the current trip (device-off or missing data).

hotspot_grid_m.title: Hotspot Grid M
hotspot_grid_m.description: Grid cell size (meters) used for hotspot clustering.

hotspot_min_samples.title: Hotspot Min Samples
hotspot_min_samples.description: Minimum samples per grid cell to qualify as a hotspot.

hotspot_max_results.title: Hotspot Max Results
hotspot_max_results.description: Maximum number of hotspots returned, sorted by sample count desc.
